_about: Master word list. Each word needs a unique 'id' (prefix w_). Translations are keyed by language code from languages.json. 'alt' lists other accepted spellings for typing exercises. 'emoji' is the placeholder shown until a real image exists. 'examples' are example sentences (prefix x_) and can have their own audio. Seed content: please have a native speaker review spelling and tone marks. Entries marked "needsReview": true were translated without a native speaker – remove the flag once checked.
